claim: Protamine can cause hypotension, pulmonary hypertension, and allergy
Immediate adverse reactions are clinically recognised
Protamine haemodynamic burden is associated with mortality
NPH insulin and allergy are risk factors
Antihistamine pretreatment has been tested prospectively
Cyclooxygenase inhibition attenuated reactions in animals
Systemic NSAID CABG warnings exist internationally
Japanese protamine rate and dose limits
Future results reporting will follow CONSORT 2025
